en: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?
Not good enough!
You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.
You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!
No, wrong!
I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!
When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.
Ow!\nThat's tragic!
Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.
Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?
Just as I thought!
This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.
Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!
You looked so cute, too!
I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.
I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.
POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.
I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.
Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!
Why not?
Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!
Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!
That can't be true!
I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.
What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON!
I said trade!
I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.
Want to play with my POKéMON?
I was too impatient!
I'll go train with weaker people.

MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!
MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.
RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.
RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!
RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…
